culprit_citations.quoted_text: Funded debt row shows First Lien with Reference SOFR(Q), Spread 4.50%, and Interest Rate 8.49%.
First Lien - Undrawn row has dashes in Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate columns.
Total Unfunded Debt Investments: principal 216,346, cost (478), fair value (270), percent of net assets (0.03)%.
Interest Rate Type summary totals 100.00% of investments at fair value.

findings.detail: C01 counts unfunded debt commitments with source dashes in the rate columns as debt rows missing rates, depressing row coverage to 65.4%.

rationale: The raw schedule distinguishes funded debt from unfunded debt commitments. Funded debt rows carry Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate values, while undrawn/unfunded debt rows have source dashes in those rate-related columns and are separately totaled as Unfunded Debt Investments with de minimis negative fair value. The C01 failure is therefore caused by including structurally unrated unfunded commitments in a debt-row rate-coverage denominator, not by a source data error in the extracted funded debt rates.
